title: Abrine targets ERK to suppress EMT and lung metastasis model via MAPKs and Nrf2/Keap-1/HO-1 signaling.
authors: Shen, Yufang; Xiao, Linyu; Liu, Lina; Liao, Lianting; Zou, Xianmin; Shen, Pengfei; Zhao, Jinlong; Yuan, Renyikun; Gao, Hongwei; Yao, Chun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Abrine靶向ERK抑制肺癌转移的机制，涉及MAPK和Nrf2信号通路，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Abrine, an indole alkaloid, was evaluated for its anti-metastatic activity and mechanism in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) models. Human A549 and H1975 cells were exposed to Abrine, showing no cytotoxicity but marked suppression of TGF-beta1-induced migration and invasion by scratch and Transwell assays. Mechanistically, Abrine reversed epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by upregulating E-cadherin and reducing N-cadherin, vimentin, Snail and Slug, findings corroborated by immunofluorescence. Abrine also diminished phosphorylation of ERK, JNK and p38 while modulating the Nrf2/Keap-1/HO-1 axis. Target engagement was supported by molecular docking, CETSA, DARTS, and MST indicating specific binding and thermal stabilization of ERK. In vivo, Abrine (20 or 40 mg/kg) mitigated lung metastasis in a B16-F10 intravenous model, improving body weight, decreasing lung metastatic burden, lung wet weight and lung index, and reducing Ki67 expression in lung tissue. Systemic effects included lowered circulating IL-17, IL-10, TNF-alpha and IFN-gamma, and absence of overt histopathological toxicity in major organs. Combination with the ERK1/2 inhibitor SCH772984 further enhanced efficacy. Collectively, Abrine exerts potent anti-metastatic effects by directly targeting ERK to inhibit MAPK signaling, reversing EMT and engaging the Nrf2/Keap-1/HO-1 pathway, highlighting Abrine alone or with ERK inhibition as a promising therapeutic strategy against lung metastasis model.
abstract_zh: Abrine，一种吲哚生物碱，在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）模型中评估了其抗转移活性及机制。人A549和H1975细胞暴露于Abrine，通过划痕和Transwell实验显示无细胞毒性，但显著抑制TGF-beta1诱导的迁移和侵袭。机制上，Abrine通过上调E-cadherin并减少N-cadherin、vimentin、Snail和Slug逆转上皮-间质转化（EMT），这一发现通过免疫荧光得到证实。Abrine还减弱了ERK、JNK和p38的磷酸化，同时调节Nrf2/Keap-1/HO-1轴。靶点结合通过分子对接、CETSA、DARTS和MST得到支持，表明与ERK的特异性结合及热稳定性增强。体内实验中，Abrine（20或40 mg/kg）在B16-F10静脉注射模型中减轻了肺转移，改善了体重，降低了肺转移负担、肺湿重和肺指数，并减少了肺组织中Ki67的表达。全身效应包括降低循环中的IL-17、IL-10、TNF-alpha和IFN-gamma，且主要器官无明显组织病理学毒性。与ERK1/2抑制剂SCH772984联合使用进一步增强了疗效。总体而言，Abrine通过直接靶向ERK抑制MAPK信号通路、逆转EMT并激活Nrf2/Keap-1/HO-1通路，发挥强效抗转移作用，突显了Abrine单独或与ERK抑制联合作为肺转移模型中有前景的治疗策略。
